Game Overview

In Flappy Plane, the core idea is straightforward: navigate perilous skies as a daring pilot in Flappy Plane. Test your reflexes with rhythmic taps to dodge obstacles, all set within stunning visuals. With every tap, chase higher scores and feel the thrill of skill-based challenges. Are you ready to perfect your flight path?
